risks.risk: Engine may not actually run well (hidden internal wear, misfiring, overheating) despite the seller’s claim.
risks.proof: Short video of the engine starting from cold and running at idle and ~1–2 load levels, plus a brief audio capture to confirm no knocking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/unknown condition (worst case: needs servicing or may not run).

risks.risk: Model/engine family may be different from what’s claimed, which changes parts availability and value.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the engine data plate/serial plate and any stamped model number (and/or a photo of the intake/exhaust side markings).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest comparable for an unidentified used marine engine in similar size class.

risks.risk: Major components may be worn: starter/alternator, fuel injection pump/injectors, cooling system, or belts/hoses.
risks.proof: Photos of fuel lines/injectors, alternator/starter, and cooling hoses/radiator condition; plus a running video showing stable charging and no smoke.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming common wear items may need replacement.

risks.risk: Coupling/prop/shaft alignment issues or gearbox/transmission problems (if included) could make it unusable.
risks.proof: Photo of the coupling/gearbox interface and a video showing engagement/prop shaft movement (if safe and applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming drivetrain/gearbox may require inspection or repair.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues not obvious in one wide shot (cracks, missing parts, seized accessories).
risks.proof: Close-ups of the block exterior, mounting points, and any missing components; list of included parts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/needs parts unless confirmed otherwise.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine data/serial plate showing brand and exact model number (not just the seller’s text).
Video of the engine starting and running (idle + brief rev), with audio to confirm 'no knock'.
Photo of hour meter/maintenance record (or any meter) to support 'low mileage'.
Photos of fuel system and cooling system components (injectors/pump, hoses, radiator/heat exchanger if present).
Photos showing what exactly is included (gearbox, alternator, starter, wiring harness, exhaust, filters) and what is missing.
response.reason: From photo 0 the exact engine model/identity cannot be confirmed, and the key value drivers (running condition, knock, mileage, and whether it was opened) are not verifiable remotely. To price safely, request the engine plate close-up and a running video.
